operations = []

final_chars = [char for row in final_state for char in row]

# Perform operations to transform initial state to final state

            # Update the positions
            initial_chars[correct_pos], initial_chars[correct_pos - 1] = initial_chars[correct_pos - 1], initial_chars[correct_pos]
